e.v: Open the Global Market at any time via its dedicated tab in the ESC menu or by pressing Left Alt + M. - Search & Filters: Use the live search bar at the top right, toggle between 'Show: All' and 'Show: Available', and switch category layouts (Detailed, Compact, A-Z) via key C or Gamepad X. - Direct Trading: Select any commodity in the list and click Buy or Sell at the bottom.
Simulated Offline Market vs. Live Online Market

- Offline Mode (Default out of the box): Without external tools, the market runs as a dynamic simulation calculating stock levels, price trends, and Great Demands locally on your map. - Online Mode (Optional): Running the optional GlobalMarketClient alongside the game connects your session to the shared global market, where real player trades worldwide drive supply and demand. In Multiplayer (including Dedicated Servers), only one connected player needs to run the client.

The compact market icon next to the top-right HUD info bar indicates your connection status: - Green: Online client active & connected (your PC is the active Data-Host). - Orange: Online client connected & on Standby (ready for automatic failover if the active Data-Host leaves). - Red: Local client is running, but currently has no connection to the online server. - Gray: Offline Mode active. A brief pulse indicates a newly synchronized online market update.
Dynamic Supply & Local Map Base Price

Market prices react continuously to global stock levels: Abundant stock lowers prices (down to -30%), while scarce stock drives prices up (up to +30%). - Fair Map Reference: Prices always scale relative to your map's genuine local selling station average, respecting economic difficulty and seasonal curves. - Trend Arrows: Green and red arrows show at a glance whether the current market price sits above or below the local normal price.
Dealer Markup, Delivery Fees & Online Cooldown

- Dealer Markup & Delivery Costs: Buying goods from the market includes a configurable dealer markup. Direct transfers to or from your own farm silos and warehouses incur delivery costs (base fee + per-liter rate). - Online Cooldown: In Live Online Mode, a brief 15-second global cooldown applies between online transactions to keep worldwide stock synchronized.
Great Demands & Hybrid Mode for Custom Goods

- Great Demands: Active Great Demand events grant substantial price bonuses for a limited time, announced via HUD notification and highlighted in the market list. - Hybrid Online Mode: Custom map or mod goods that are awaiting online review ('Pending | Offline') or marked local-only ('Offline Only') remain seamlessly tradable via the local market simulation.
Farm Silos, Object Storages & Format Selection

Global Market automatically detects all owned bulk and liquid silos as well as bale and pallet warehouses built on standard GIANTS specializations. - Flexible Container Choice: In the trade dialog, select your target storage and choose your preferred format for object storages (Round/Square Bales, Pallet, BigBag, or IBC Tank). - Silage Note: Actively fermenting bales are locked from trading until fermentation is complete.

Dedicated Global Market storage buildings (XML attribute 'isGmMarket') act as shared logistics hubs: - 0 $CURRENCY_SYMBOL Delivery Costs: Because you physically deliver or pick up goods at the terminal yourself, all delivery fees are waived. - Strict Per-Farm Isolation in Multiplayer: Multiple farms can use the same terminal simultaneously - bulk levels, bales, and pallets are strictly isolated per farm.

Goods stored long-term inside a GM Logistics Terminal incur monthly storage fees. - Maximum Storage Duration: If stored stock exceeds the configured limit in a GM Terminal (default: 6 months), advance warnings are shown before overdue stock is automatically cleared. Your own private farm silos are never affected.

All Global Market purchases, sales, and fees are tracked in the native FS25 Finances screen. - In the Game Settings, each player can freely choose between a compact summary view or a detailed breakdown by bulk goods, liquids, bales, pallets, and fees.

A dedicated Global Market section is available in the General Game Settings: - Server / Admin Settings: Configure delivery costs (base & per liter), dealer markup, market capacity, storage clearance duration, Great Demand mode, plus compatibility and debug options (saved separately for Singleplayer, MP Host, and Dedicated Server). - Local Player Settings: HUD status icon visibility, icon pulse, and detailed finance display can be customized individually by every player.
